questions.why: 뒤에 동사원형 arrive가 오므로 목적을 나타내는 so as to를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
그 상자는 너무 커서 내 사물함에 들어가지 않았다.
<조건> so ~ that을 사용하고 총 12단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: The box was so big that it did not fit my locker.
questions.why: The/box/was/so/big/that/it/did/not/fit/my/locker의 12단어이다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
나는 내 개가 도망가지 않도록 문을 닫았다.
<조건> so that과 would를 사용하고 총 12단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: I closed the gate so that my dog would not run away.
questions.why: I/closed/the/gate/so/that/my/dog/would/not/run/away의 12단어이다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
그것은 매우 어려운 질문이어서 아무도 손을 들지 않았다.
<조건> such를 사용하고 총 11단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: It was such a hard question that nobody raised a hand.
questions.why: It/was/such/a/hard/question/that/nobody/raised/a/hand의 11단어이다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
우리는 좋은 자리를 잡기 위해 한 시간 일찍 도착했다.
<조건> in order to를 사용하고 총 11단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: We arrived an hour early in order to get good seats.
questions.why: We/arrived/an/hour/early/in/order/to/get/good/seats의 11단어이다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
그 길은 너무 좁아서 두 대의 차가 지나갈 수 없었다.
<조건> too를 사용하고 총 10단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: The road was too narrow for two cars to pass.
questions.why: The/road/was/too/narrow/for/two/cars/to/pass의 10단어이다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
그녀는 실수를 하지 않기 위해 천천히 말했다.
<조건> so as not to를 사용하고 총 10단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: She spoke slowly so as not to make a mistake.
questions.why: She/spoke/slowly/so/as/not/to/make/a/mistake의 10단어이다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
그 나무는 매우 높아서 우리는 꼭대기를 볼 수 없었다.
<조건> so ~ that을 사용하고 총 12단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: The tree was so tall that we could not see the top.
questions.why: The/tree/was/so/tall/that/we/could/not/see/the/top의 12단어이다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안의 말을 어법에 맞게 바꿔 쓰시오.
[감기 예방]
I put on a mask in order not to (catching) ____ a cold.
questions.why: in order not to 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 catch로 바꾼다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안의 말을 어법에 맞게 바꿔 쓰시오.
[야영장 밤]
They spoke quietly so as not to (waking) ____ the other campers.
questions.why: so as not to 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 wake로 바꾼다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안의 말을 어법에 맞게 바꿔 쓰시오.
[하교 버스에서]
He was so tired that he (fall) ____ asleep on the bus.
questions.why: 주절이 과거이므로 that절의 동사도 과거형 fell로 바꾼다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안의 말을 어법에 맞게 바꿔 쓰시오.
[할아버지의 지도]
It was such (a) ____ old map that the names were hard to read.
questions.why: old는 모음으로 소리 나므로 「such+an+형용사+명사」의 형태가 된다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안의 말을 어법에 맞게 바꿔 쓰시오.
[놀이공원 출발 전]
The children were so excited that they (can) ____ not sit still.
questions.why: 주절이 과거이므로 that절의 조동사도 과거형 could로 바꾼다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The science lab must ____ before six o'clock.
questions.why: 조동사가 있는 수동태는 「조동사+be+p.p.」이므로 must be locked가 알맞다. 나머지는 모두 능동형이거나 조동사 뒤에 올 수 없는 형태이다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
These plastic bottles can ____ into new chairs.
questions.why: 병은 재활용되는 대상이므로 can be recycled가 알맞다. be recycling은 능동 진행의 뜻이 된다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
All the tickets will ____ at the front gate.
questions.why: 표는 검사되는 대상이므로 미래 수동태 will be checked가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Cell phones should not ____ during the school concert.
questions.why: 부정 조동사 수동태는 「조동사+not+be+p.p.」이므로 should not be used가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Young trees may ____ along the river next spring.
questions.why: 나무는 심어지는 대상이므로 may be planted가 알맞다. may 뒤에는 동사원형 be가 온다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
This puzzle cannot ____ in five minutes.
questions.why: 퍼즐은 풀리는 대상이므로 cannot be solved가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The lights in the hallway have to ____ before we leave.
questions.why: have to 뒤에는 동사원형이 오고 불이 꺼지는 대상이므로 be turned off가 알맞다. 동사구 수동태에서는 off를 빠뜨리면 안 된다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The first prize was given ____ the youngest player.
questions.why: give는 4형식 수동태에서 간접목적어 앞에 to를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A warm sweater was bought ____ me by my aunt.
questions.why: buy는 4형식 수동태에서 간접목적어 앞에 for를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
We ____ a short quiz by our English teacher last Monday.
questions.why: 우리가 시험지를 받은 것이므로 수동태이고, 주어가 We이며 지난 월요일 일이므로 were given이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The little robot was ____ Coco by the science club.
questions.why: 「name+목적어+보어」의 수동태이므로 was named 뒤에 보어 Coco가 바로 온다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The players were made ____ ten more laps by the coach.
questions.why: 사역동사 make가 수동태가 되면 목적격보어인 동사원형이 to부정사로 바뀌므로 were made to run이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The windows were kept ____ all afternoon because of the smell.
questions.why: 「keep+목적어+형용사」의 수동태이므로 were kept 뒤에 형용사 open이 온다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The whole hill was covered ____ white snow.
questions.why: be covered with는 '~로 덮여 있다'라는 뜻으로 by 대신 with를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? (그 김치로 유명하다)
My grandmother is known ____ her delicious kimchi.
questions.why: be known for는 '~로 유명하다'라는 뜻이다. be known to는 '~에게 알려져 있다', be known as는 '~로서 알려져 있다'이다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? (세 명의 사육사가 그 코끼리를 돌본다)
The baby elephant is looked ____ by three keepers.
questions.why: look after(돌보다)의 수동태는 be looked after이다. look for는 '찾다', look into는 '조사하다'라는 뜻이다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[학교 도서관 이용 안내]
questions.why: ④는 잡지가 놓이는 대상이므로 will be placed로 고쳐야 한다. will be placing은 능동 진행의 뜻이다.
choices: Books must be returned within two weeks.
The reading room can be used until nine.
Late fees should be paid at the front desk.
New magazines will be placing on the shelf.
Drinks may not be brought inside the library.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[박물관 관람 안내]
questions.why: ①은 「조동사+be+p.p.」 형태여야 하므로 should be closed로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The gift shop should be closes at six.
Photos cannot be taken in this hall.
The old vase must be handled with care.
Big bags have to be left at the entrance.
Group tickets can be bought online.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[교실 청소 규칙]
questions.why: ⑤는 조동사 뒤에 be가 빠졌으므로 can be opened로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The floor must be swept every Friday.
The desks should be moved to the back.
The trash can has to be emptied every day.
The board may be cleaned after the last class.
The windows can opened by the students.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[생일 선물 이야기]
questions.why: ①의 buy는 간접목적어 앞에 for를 쓰므로 was bought for my cousin으로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: A new bike was bought to my cousin.
A silver ring was given to my sister.
A big pizza was ordered for the whole family.
A funny card was sent to her best friend.
The recipe was shown to us by Mom.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[영어 시간]
questions.why: ③은 give의 과거분사가 given이므로 was given으로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: We were taught a new song by Ms. Han.
I was told the news by my classmate.
I was gave a free bookmark by the staff.
They were shown a short movie in class.
She was sent a long letter last week.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[학급 회의]
questions.why: ①은 사역동사 make의 수동태이므로 목적격보어를 to부정사로 바꾸어 were made to write로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The students were made write their names on the list.
The plan was called a great idea by the teacher.
The door was left open during the meeting.
Our team was named the Blue Wings.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[체육 시간]
questions.why: ⑤는 지각동사 hear의 수동태이므로 was heard to sing 또는 was heard singing으로 고쳐야 한다. 동사원형 sing은 올 수 없다.
choices: Two students were seen to enter the gym late.
The ball was found broken under the bench.
We were made to warm up for ten minutes.
The floor was kept clean by our class.
Jina was heard sing loudly in the hallway.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[우리 가족]
questions.why: ③은 be interested in(~에 관심이 있다)이므로 interested in으로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: My father is satisfied with his new job.
The kitchen was filled with the smell of bread.
My brother is interested on model airplanes.
My mother is worried about her old car.
We were surprised at the sudden news.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[토요일 시장 풍경]
questions.why: ②는 '~로 유명하다'라는 뜻이므로 be known for를 써서 known for its cheap prices로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The market is crowded with shoppers on Saturday.
The little shop is known with its cheap prices.
The baskets are filled with fresh fruit.
That long desk is made of old wood.
This soft bread is made from rice.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[동아리 활동 보고]
questions.why: ④는 take care of의 수동태이므로 of를 살려 is taken care of by two members로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The club trip was put off until next month.
The broken chairs were dealt with quickly.
Our club leader is looked up to by everyone.
The stray cat is taken care by two members.
The meeting was called off because of the storm.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[캠핑 준비]
questions.why: ①은 「조동사+be+p.p.」이므로 must be thrown away로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The trash must be throw away before we leave.
Can the tent be set up in ten minutes?
Water should be boiled before drinking.
The fire must not be left alone at night.
The food will be kept in the cool box.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[학교 축제 준비]
questions.why: ⑤의 let은 수동태로 쓰지 않으므로 was allowed to play로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The posters will be printed tomorrow morning.
The stage must be built by Friday evening.
Free drinks were offered to the visitors.
The hall was decorated with paper flowers.
The band was let play three more songs.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[방과 후 교실]
questions.why: ④가 「조동사+be+p.p.」를 바르게 지킨 문장이다. ①은 must be turned, ②는 can be locked, ③은 should be put, ⑤는 will be closed로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The lights must turned off at six.
The door can be lock from the inside.
The books should be putting on the shelf.
The computers may be used until five.
The window will be close by the guard.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[선물을 받은 날]
questions.why: ⑤가 옳다. send와 tell은 to, make는 for를 쓰고 give의 과거분사는 given이므로 ①은 to, ②는 for, ③은 was given, ④는 to로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: A card was sent for my grandmother.
A cake was made to my little brother.
A big prize was gave to the winner.
A story was told for the little children.
A ticket was given to me by my aunt.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[학급 임원 선거]
questions.why: ③이 옳다. ①은 was elected, ②는 was called, ④는 was kept, ⑤는 was seen to enter로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Suho was elect class leader last week.
The result was call a big surprise.
We were made to write a short speech.
The name list was keep in the drawer.
He was seen enter the office at noon.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[박물관에서]
questions.why: ②가 옳다. ①은 be taken, ③은 be borrowed, ④는 be left, ⑤는 be locked로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Photos must not be took inside the hall.
The old coins can be seen on the second floor.
The guide book may be borrow at the desk.
Big bags should be leaving in the locker room.
The heavy doors will be lock at five.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[요리 수업]
questions.why: ①이 옳다. ②는 조리법이 보여지는 대상이므로 was shown, ③은 lent to me, ④는 was bought, ⑤는 was taught로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The soup was made for us by the chef.
The recipe was showing to everyone.
A sharp knife was lent for me.
The bread was buy for our class.
The sauce was teach to us in ten minutes.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[여러 가지 표현]
questions.why: ④가 옳다. ①은 covered with, ②는 interested in, ③은 known to, ⑤는 pleased with로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The playground was covered of thin ice.
I am interested at Korean history.
She is known in everyone in this town.
The glass jar was filled with dry beans.
We were pleased of his kind answer.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[동사구가 쓰인 문장]
questions.why: ④가 옳다. ①은 taken care of, ②는 called off, ③은 laughed at, ⑤는 were thrown away로 고쳐야 한다. 동사구는 수동태에서도 한 덩어리로 움직인다.
choices: The puppy was taken care by Mr. Han.
The concert was call off yesterday.
He was laughed by his own classmates.
The school event was put off until next week.
The old letters were throw away by mistake.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[과학실 안전 규칙]
questions.why: ⑤가 옳다. ①은 be turned off, ②는 be worn, ③은 be cleaned, ④는 be tied back으로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The machine has to be turn off after use.
Safety glasses must be wore at all times.
The desks ought to be cleaning after class.
Long hair should be tie back.
Food may not be brought into the lab.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[집 안 풍경]
questions.why: ②가 옳다. ①은 was named, ③은 left broken, ④는 was called, ⑤는 were made to wash로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The baby was name Suji by her parents.
The room was kept warm by the old heater.
The window was left broke all night long.
Our dog was call Bingo by the kids.
The kids were made washed the dishes.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[여러 문장 점검]
questions.why: ③이 옳다. ①은 be handed in, ②는 given to, ④는 interested in, ⑤는 was made clean으로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The homework must be hand in by Monday.
A free map was given for every visitor.
The old trees are looked after by the gardener.
I was interested with the new board game.
The stage was made cleaned before the show.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐShould be the classroom ⓑcleaned ⓒby the students ⓓafter ⓔthe last class?
questions.why: 수동태 의문문은 「조동사+주어+be+p.p.」 순서이므로 ⓐ를 Should the classroom으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐThese old letters ⓑcan sent ⓒto the city museum ⓓby our club ⓔnext week.
questions.why: 조동사 뒤에는 be가 필요하므로 ⓑ를 can be sent로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐA new song ⓑwas ⓒteach ⓓto our class ⓔby the music club.
questions.why: teach의 과거분사는 taught이므로 ⓒ를 taught로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐThe gym floor ⓑmust ⓒbe ⓓpaint ⓔbefore the big game.
questions.why: 「조동사+be+p.p.」이므로 ⓓ를 painted로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐA new soccer ball ⓑwill ⓒbe ⓓbought ⓔto our class by the school.
questions.why: buy는 4형식 수동태에서 간접목적어 앞에 for를 쓰므로 ⓔ를 for our class로 고쳐야 한다. bought 뒤에는 to를 쓰지 않는다.
choices: ⓔ to our class by the school

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐWas given I ⓑa free ticket ⓒat the entrance ⓓby the staff ⓔlast Saturday?
questions.why: 수동태 의문문은 「be동사+주어+p.p.」 순서이므로 ⓐ를 Was I given으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐThe students ⓑwere made clean ⓒthe art room ⓓafter school ⓔlast Friday.
questions.why: 사역동사 make의 수동태에서는 목적격보어가 to부정사가 되므로 ⓑ를 were made to clean으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐA thick blanket ⓑwas ⓒgave ⓓto each child ⓔby the volunteers.
questions.why: give의 과거분사는 given이므로 ⓒ를 given으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은? (삼촌은 마을 사람 모두에게 알려져 있다)
ⓐMy uncle ⓑis ⓒknown ⓓfor everyone ⓔin this quiet town.
questions.why: '~에게 알려져 있다'는 be known to이므로 ⓓ를 to everyone으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐThe old stone bridge ⓑcannot ⓒbe ⓓcrossed ⓔuntil the broken parts are repair.
questions.why: ⓔ의 절도 수동태이므로 be동사 뒤에 과거분사를 써야 한다. until the broken parts are repaired로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: ⓔ until the broken parts are repair

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
Our school started a green campaign last month. ⓐ Paper must be put into the blue box. ⓑ Cans and bottles should be washed before they are thrown away. ⓒ Old notebooks can be used again as note pads. ⓓ The boxes will be take out by the cleaning staff every Friday. ⓔ Any student may be asked to help for one week.
questions.why: ⓓ는 「조동사+be+p.p.」이므로 will be taken out으로 고쳐야 한다. take out은 수동태에서도 out을 살려 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
Yesterday was a busy day at the animal center. ⓐ A small dog was brought to the center in the morning. ⓑ It was given a warm bath by two volunteers. ⓒ A soft bed was made for it near the window. ⓓ The dog was name Lucky by the staff. ⓔ Later it was shown to a family from our town.
questions.why: ⓓ는 「name+목적어+보어」의 수동태이므로 was named Lucky로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
Our town pool opens next week. ⓐ Swimming caps must be wearing by everyone. ⓑ Long hair should be tied back. ⓒ Towels can be rented at the front desk. ⓓ Food may not be eaten near the water. ⓔ Small children have to be watched by an adult.
questions.why: ⓐ는 모자가 쓰이는 대상이므로 must be worn으로 고쳐야 한다. be wearing은 능동 진행의 뜻이다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
My grandmother kept a small shop for thirty years. ⓐ Free candy was given to every child. ⓑ Warm tea was made for tired visitors. ⓒ Her old recipes were teach to my mother. ⓓ A thank-you letter was sent to her last winter. ⓔ A small gift was bought for her by our family.
questions.why: ⓒ의 teach는 과거분사가 taught이므로 were taught to my mother로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
The drama club chose a new play last week. ⓐ Minji was elected leader of the club. ⓑ The play was called a bold choice by our teacher. ⓒ The stage was kept dark until the last scene. ⓓ Two members were made to learn twenty pages by heart. ⓔ The youngest member was heard cry behind the curtain.
questions.why: ⓔ는 지각동사 hear의 수동태이므로 was heard crying 또는 was heard to cry로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
I visited my cousin's farm last summer. ⓐ The wide field was covered with yellow flowers. ⓑ I was surprised of the size of the old barn. ⓒ The baskets were filled with fresh eggs every morning. ⓓ My cousin is known to everyone in the village. ⓔ I was very pleased with the quiet nights there.
questions.why: ⓑ는 be surprised at(~에 놀라다)이므로 surprised at the size로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
Our class started a small library in the hallway. ⓐ Old books were brought in by the students. ⓑ Broken covers were dealt with by two volunteers. ⓒ The opening day was put off once because of exams. ⓓ Every book is taken care by the class monitor. ⓔ Our reading hour was called off only once this year.
questions.why: ⓓ는 take care of의 수동태이므로 is taken care of by로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
The city built a new bike road along the river. ⓐ The road must be shared with walkers. ⓑ Helmets should be worn by all young riders. ⓒ Bikes can be rented near the east gate. ⓓ Broken bikes should be reported to the office. ⓔ The whole road will be light by new lamps this fall.
questions.why: ⓔ의 light는 과거분사가 lit(=lighted)이므로 will be lit으로 고쳐야 한다. 동사원형 light는 be 뒤에 올 수 없다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 뜻이 같도록 옮긴 것으로 알맞은 것은?
그 편지는 오늘 밤까지 부쳐져야 한다.
questions.why: 「조동사+be+p.p.」 형태인 must be mailed가 알맞다.
choices: The letter must mail by tonight.
The letter must be mailed by tonight.
The letter must be mailing by tonight.
The letter must mailed by tonight.
The letter must to be mailed by tonight.

questions.stem:
우리말과 뜻이 같도록 옮긴 것으로 알맞은 것은?
이 방은 손님들이 사용할 수 없다.
questions.why: 부정 조동사 수동태는 「조동사+not+be+p.p.」이므로 cannot be used가 알맞다.
choices: This room cannot be used by guests.
This room cannot use by guests.
This room cannot be using by guests.
This room can be not used by guests.
This room cannot used by guests.

questions.stem:
우리말과 뜻이 같도록 옮긴 것으로 알맞은 것은?
새 표지판이 다음 주에 세워질 것이다.
questions.why: put up의 수동태는 be put up이고 put의 과거분사도 put이므로 will be put up이 알맞다.
choices: A new sign will put up next week.
A new sign will be putting up next week.
A new sign will be put up next week.
A new sign will putted up next week.
A new sign is going to put up next week.

questions.stem:
우리말과 뜻이 같도록 옮긴 것으로 알맞은 것은?
그 무거운 상자는 한 사람이 옮길 수 없다.
questions.why: cannot 뒤에는 be+p.p.가 와야 하므로 cannot be carried가 알맞다.
choices: The heavy box cannot carry by one person.
The heavy box cannot be carry by one person.
The heavy box cannot being carried by one person.
The heavy box is not can be carried by one person.
The heavy box cannot be carried by one person.

questions.stem:
우리말과 뜻이 같도록 옮긴 것으로 알맞은 것은?
나는 삼촌에게서 오래된 카메라를 받았다.
questions.why: 4형식 문장의 간접목적어를 주어로 한 수동태이므로 I was given ~ by my uncle이 알맞다. give는 for가 아니라 to를 쓰고, 행위자 앞에는 by를 쓴다.
choices: I was gave an old camera by my uncle.
An old camera was given for me by my uncle.
I was given an old camera by my uncle.
I was given an old camera for my uncle.
I gave an old camera by my uncle.

questions.stem:
우리말과 뜻이 같도록 옮긴 것으로 알맞은 것은?
따뜻한 수프가 우리를 위해 만들어졌다.
questions.why: make는 4형식 수동태에서 간접목적어 앞에 for를 쓴다.
choices: Warm soup was made to us.
Warm soup was make for us.
Warm soup was making for us.
Warm soup was made of us.
Warm soup was made for us.

questions.stem:
우리말과 뜻이 같도록 옮긴 것으로 알맞은 것은?
그 소년들은 선생님에 의해 창문을 닦아야 했다.
questions.why: 사역동사 make의 수동태에서는 목적격보어인 동사원형이 to부정사로 바뀌므로 were made to wash가 알맞다.
choices: The boys were made wash the windows by the teacher.
The boys were made washing the windows by the teacher.
The boys were make to wash the windows by the teacher.
The boys made to wash the windows by the teacher.
The boys were made to wash the windows by the teacher.

questions.stem:
우리말과 뜻이 같도록 옮긴 것으로 알맞은 것은?
그 문은 밤새 열린 채로 있었다.
questions.why: 「leave+목적어+형용사」의 수동태이므로 was left 뒤에 형용사 open이 온다.
choices: The door was left open all night.
The door was left opening all night.
The door was leave open all night.
The door left was open all night.
The door was left to open all night.

questions.stem:
우리말과 뜻이 같도록 옮긴 것으로 알맞은 것은?
그 산길은 짙은 안개로 덮여 있었다.
questions.why: be covered with는 '~로 덮여 있다'라는 뜻으로 by 대신 with를 쓴다.
choices: The mountain path was covered of thick fog.
The mountain path was covered with thick fog.
The mountain path was covering with thick fog.
The mountain path was cover with thick fog.
The mountain path was covered for thick fog.

questions.stem:
우리말과 뜻이 같도록 옮긴 것으로 알맞은 것은?
길 잃은 그 강아지는 두 학생에게 돌봐졌다.
questions.why: take care of는 한 덩어리로 움직이므로 수동태에서도 of를 빠뜨리면 안 된다.
choices: The lost puppy was taken care by two students.
The lost puppy was took care of by two students.
The lost puppy took care of by two students.
The lost puppy was taken of care by two students.
The lost puppy was taken care of by two students.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
The old wall must (A)____ before the rainy season.
These forms can (B)____ at the front office.
The back gate should not (C)____ open at night.
questions.why: 세 문장 모두 「조동사(+not)+be+p.p.」 형태가 필요하므로 be fixed - be signed - be left가 알맞다.
choices: be fix - be signed - be left
be fixed - be signed - be left

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
A long letter was sent (A)____ my aunt.
A new winter coat was bought (B)____ the youngest child.
A few questions were asked (C)____ the tour guide.
questions.why: send는 to, buy는 for, ask는 of를 간접목적어 앞에 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
The hall was filled (A)____ excited fans.
My sister is interested (B)____ old maps.
We were surprised (C)____ the loud sound.
questions.why: be filled with, be interested in, be surprised at는 by 대신 다른 전치사를 쓰는 대표적인 표현이다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
The puppy was (A)____ Bori by the twins.
The reading room was kept (B)____ during the test.
The students were made (C)____ the heavy desks.
questions.why: (A)는 「name+목적어+보어」의 수동태, (B)는 「keep+목적어+형용사」의 수동태, (C)는 사역동사 make의 수동태이므로 named - quiet - to move가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
The outdoor concert was called (A)____ because of the snow.
The sick bird is taken care (B)____ by our club.
Our coach is looked up (C)____ by all the players.
questions.why: call off(취소하다), take care of(돌보다), look up to(존경하다)는 수동태에서도 부사·전치사를 그대로 살려 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
Cars must not (A)____ in front of the school gate.
The singer was heard (B)____ in the next room.
The heavy boxes will (C)____ to the new office tomorrow.
questions.why: (A)와 (C)는 「조동사+be+p.p.」, (B)는 지각동사 hear의 수동태로 목적격보어가 to부정사가 되므로 be parked - to practice - be moved가 알맞다.
choices: be parking - to practice - be moved
be parked - to practice - be moved

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
That writer is known (A)____ his short stories. (그 작품으로 유명하다)
His face is known (B)____ almost every student. (모두에게 알려져 있다)
He is also known (C)____ a kind neighbor. (~로서 알려져 있다)
questions.why: be known for는 '~로 유명하다', be known to는 '~에게 알려져 있다', be known as는 '~로서 알려져 있다'라는 뜻이다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
The window must (A)____ by the strong wind last night. (깨진 것이 틀림없다)
This machine cannot (B)____ by young children.
The report has to (C)____ by Friday afternoon.
questions.why: '~되었음이 틀림없다'는 「must have been p.p.」이고, cannot과 has to 뒤에도 be+p.p.가 온다. hand in은 한 덩어리이므로 in을 빠뜨리면 안 된다.
choices: have broken - be touched - be handed in
have been broken - be touched - be handed in
have been broken - touch - hand in
have been breaking - be touched - be handed in
have been broken - be touching - be handed

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Why is the gym closed today?
B: The floor ____ this morning, so no one can walk on it.
questions.why: 바닥은 왁스칠을 당하는 대상이고 오늘 아침에 끝난 일이므로 과거 수동태 was waxed가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: When will the contest results come out?
B: They ____ on the school website tomorrow.
questions.why: 결과는 게시되는 대상이므로 미래 수동태 will be posted가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Can I take my dog into the flower garden?
B: Sorry, pets cannot ____ inside the fence.
questions.why: cannot 뒤에는 be+p.p.가 와야 하므로 cannot be brought가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Is the science room open now?
B: Not yet. It ____ at nine by Mr. Park.
questions.why: 문이 열리는 대상이므로 미래 수동태 will be unlocked가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: That scarf looks new. Did you buy it?
B: No. I ____ this scarf by my aunt for my birthday.
questions.why: '내가 받았다'라는 뜻이므로 4형식 수동태 was given이 알맞다. 주어가 I이므로 was를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Your dog always looks so clean.
B: Yes, he ____ every weekend by my older brother.
questions.why: take care of의 수동태는 be taken care of이며 of를 반드시 살려 쓴다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Why does everyone listen to Mr. Yoon?
B: He ____ by all the students in our school.
questions.why: look up to(존경하다)의 수동태는 be looked up to이다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: I heard the school trip was cancelled.
B: Right. It ____ because of the typhoon warning.
questions.why: call off(취소하다)의 수동태는 be called off이다.

questions.stem:
어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ⓐ The old piano must be moved to the music room.
ⓑ These chairs can stacked in the corner.
ⓒ The curtains should be washing this week.
ⓓ The clock may be fixed by Mr. Choi.
ⓔ The back wall will paint by the art club.
questions.why: 옳은 것은 ⓐ, ⓓ 두 개이다. ⓑ는 can be stacked, ⓒ는 should be washed, ⓔ는 will be painted로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ⓐ A warm blanket was given to the old man.
ⓑ A cheese sandwich was made for my brother.
ⓒ The city map was show to the new students.
ⓓ A short poem was read to the class by Mina.
ⓔ A new pen was bought to me by my father.
questions.why: 옳은 것은 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓓ 세 개이다. ⓒ는 show의 과거분사 shown을 써서 was shown, ⓔ는 was bought for me로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ⓐ The cat was call Nabi by the children.
ⓑ The boys were made to carry the boxes.
ⓒ The gate was left opening all night.
ⓓ She was heard sing in the practice room.
ⓔ He was elect captain of the school team.
questions.why: 옳은 것은 ⓑ 하나뿐이다. ⓐ는 was called, ⓒ는 was left open, ⓓ는 was heard singing, ⓔ는 was elected로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ⓐ The wooden box was filled with old photos.
ⓑ I am interested in Korean folk songs.
ⓒ The narrow street was crowded with tourists.
ⓓ We were satisfied of the school lunch.
ⓔ The roof was covered with green moss.
questions.why: 옳은 것은 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ, ⓔ 네 개이다. ⓓ는 be satisfied with이므로 satisfied with로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ⓐ The picnic was put off until next Friday.
ⓑ The old man is looked after by his son.
ⓒ The complaint was dealt by the leader.
ⓓ He was laughed by the other players.
ⓔ The lights were turn off at ten.
questions.why: 옳은 것은 ⓐ, ⓑ 두 개이다. ⓒ는 dealt with, ⓓ는 laughed at, ⓔ는 were turned off로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ⓐ Bikes must not be parked in front of the door.
ⓑ The room was kept warm by a small heater.
ⓒ A free badge was given for every visitor.
ⓓ The song can be heard from the next room.
ⓔ The homework should be hand in by Monday.
questions.why: 옳은 것은 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓓ 세 개이다. ⓒ는 given to, ⓔ는 be handed in으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ⓐ The stone bridge cannot be cross by heavy trucks.
ⓑ The window must have been broken by the wind.
ⓒ The parcels will be send tomorrow morning.
ⓓ The baby was name after her grandmother.
ⓔ The heavy boxes were carry by two workers.
questions.why: 옳은 것은 ⓑ 하나뿐이다. ⓐ는 be crossed, ⓒ는 be sent, ⓓ는 was named, ⓔ는 were carried로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
ⓐ The front gate must be locked at night.
ⓑ The plants should watered every morning.

questions.why: hand in의 수동태는 be handed in이고 '~까지'는 by를 쓴다. 총 8단어이다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
그 소포는 우리 삼촌에 의해 보내졌다.
<조건> 총 7단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: The parcel was sent by my uncle.
questions.why: send의 과거분사는 sent이고 행위자는 by로 연결한다. 총 7단어이다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
그 방은 하루 종일 따뜻하게 유지되었다.
<조건> keep을 알맞은 형태로 쓰고 총 7단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: The room was kept warm all day.
questions.why: 「keep+목적어+형용사」의 수동태이므로 was kept 뒤에 형용사 warm이 온다. 총 7단어이다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
그 콘서트는 그 비 때문에 취소되었다.
<조건> call off를 사용하고 총 9단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: The concert was called off because of the rain.
questions.why: call off의 수동태는 be called off이며 뒤에 이유를 because of로 연결한다. 총 9단어이다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
그 아이들은 손을 씻게 되었다.
<조건> make를 알맞은 형태로 쓰고 총 8단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: The children were made to wash their hands.
questions.why: 사역동사 make의 수동태이므로 목적격보어가 to부정사가 되어 were made to wash가 된다. 총 8단어이다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Please send me the club photos as soon as ____.
questions.why: as ~ as possible은 '가능한 한 ~하게'라는 뜻으로 as ... as 뒤에 형용사 possible을 쓴다. possibly는 부사이고, can·able은 주어 없이 혼자 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
As the sun rose, the sky became brighter and ____.
questions.why: 「비교급+and+비교급」은 '점점 더 ~한'이라는 뜻으로 두 자리 모두 비교급을 쓴다. 따라서 brighter and brighter가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Kimjang is one of the oldest ____ in Korean culture.
questions.why: 「one of the+최상급+복수명사」는 '가장 ~한 것들 중 하나'라는 뜻이므로 최상급 뒤에는 복수명사 traditions를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
I walked as slowly as ____ so my little sister could follow me.
questions.why: as ~ as possible의 형태이므로 형용사 possible이 알맞다. possibly는 부사, possibility는 명사라서 이 자리에 올 수 없다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Ticket prices for the school concert became more and ____ expensive.
questions.why: expensive처럼 긴 형용사는 「more and more+원급」으로 '점점 더 ~한'을 나타내므로 more and more expensive가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
One of the tallest ____ in our class is Minsu.
questions.why: 「one of the+최상급+복수명사」 형태이므로 tallest 뒤에는 복수명사 boys가 와야 한다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The firefighters arrived as fast as they ____ when the alarm rang.
questions.why: rang이 과거이므로 「as ~ as 주어+can」의 can도 과거형 could로 쓴다. possible을 쓰려면 주어 they가 없어야 한다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
As the singer walked onto the stage, the cheering grew ____.
questions.why: '점점 더 ~한'은 「비교급+and+비교급」으로 나타내므로 louder and louder가 알맞다. 한쪽만 비교급으로 쓰면 안 된다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
One of the questions on the science test ____ really hard.
questions.why: 「one of+복수명사」가 주어일 때 주어의 핵심은 One이므로 단수동사를 쓴다. 과거의 일이므로 was가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The teacher told us to write down as ____ ideas as possible.
questions.why: ideas는 셀 수 있는 명사의 복수형이므로 「as many+복수명사+as possible」로 쓴다. much는 셀 수 없는 명사에 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Robots in factories are becoming ____ and more useful every year.
questions.why: useful은 긴 형용사이므로 「more and more+원급」의 형태로 '점점 더 유용한'을 나타낸다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Boseong Green Tea Field is one of ____ places to visit in early spring.
questions.why: 「one of the+최상급+복수명사」 형태이므로 the most colorful places가 알맞다. 최상급 앞의 the를 빠뜨리면 안 된다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[학교 축제 준비]
questions.why: ②는 「비교급+and+비교급」이므로 noisy를 noisier로 바꿔 noisier and noisier로 써야 한다. 나머지는 모두 옳다.
choices: Please hand in the poster as early as possible.
The music room is getting noisy and noisier every day.
Our club is one of the busiest groups in school.
We should practice as much as we can.
The stage looks better and better after each rehearsal.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[체육 대회]
questions.why: ④의 possibly는 부사이므로 as ~ as possible의 형용사 possible로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The runners went faster and faster around the track.
Dodgeball is one of the most exciting games in our school.
Kick the ball as far as you can.
Our team practiced as hard as possibly last week.
The gym got hotter and hotter during the game.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[도서관 이용 안내]
questions.why: ①은 「one of the+최상급+복수명사」이므로 library를 복수형 libraries로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: This is one of the oldest library in our city.
One of the quietest places in town is this reading room.
The reading room is getting more and more comfortable every year.
Please speak as quietly as possible.
Reading a novel here is one of my favorite activities.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[환경 캠페인]
questions.why: ③ as ~ as possible 사이에는 비교급이 아니라 원급이 와야 하므로 more를 much로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The smell near the old factory is becoming worse and worse.
Plastic waste is one of the biggest problems on the earth.
We must cut plastic use as more as possible.
Turn off the lights as often as you can.
More and more students join the clean-up walk every month.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[여행 계획]
questions.why: ⑤는 최상급 뒤에 복수명사가 와야 하므로 island를 islands로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Sokcho Beach is one of the most crowded places in summer.
Book the train tickets as early as possible.
The hotel prices got higher and higher near the holiday.
We packed as lightly as we could.
Namhae is one of the greenest island in Korea.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[겨울 캠핑]
questions.why: ③이 옳다. ①은 thicker and thicker, ②는 as ~ as 뒤에 형용사 possible, ④는 최상급 뒤 복수명사 items, ⑤는 smaller and smaller로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The snow became thick and thicker on the road.
We set up the tent as quickly as possibly.
One of the coldest nights of the year is coming.
A sleeping bag is one of the most useful item.
The fire got small and small.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[학교 급식]
questions.why: ⑤가 옳다. ①은 dishes, ②는 possible, ③은 longer and longer, ④는 is로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Kimchi stew is one of the tastiest dish in the cafeteria.
Wash your hands as carefully as possibly.
The lunch line grew long and longer today.
One of the cooks are making tteokbokki.
We should throw away as little food as possible.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[과학 시간]
questions.why: ②가 옳다. ①은 more and more 뒤에 비교급을 겹쳐 쓸 수 없으므로 cleaner and cleaner, ③은 as ~ as 뒤의 형용사 possible, ④는 taller and taller, ⑤는 최상급 뒤 복수명사 planets로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Water is becoming more and more cleaner in this river.
One of the most surprising facts is that ice floats on water.
Measure the temperature as exactly as possibly.
The plant grew tall and taller under the lamp.
Mercury is one of the smallest planet in the solar system.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[동아리 발표]
questions.why: ④가 옳다. ①은 possible, ②는 better and better, ③은 topics, ⑤는 is로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Speak as loudly as possibly during the presentation.
The slides became more and more better.
This is one of the hardest topic we have studied.
Our audience got bigger and bigger every year.
One of the members are recording the show.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐPlease greet ⓑthe new students ⓒas polite as ⓓpossible ⓔon the first day.
questions.why: 동사 greet를 꾸미는 자리이므로 형용사 polite가 아니라 부사 politely를 써서 as politely as로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐThe sky ⓑoutside the window ⓒturned ⓓdark and darker ⓔduring the storm.
questions.why: 「비교급+and+비교급」이므로 dark를 darker로 바꿔 darker and darker로 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐOne of my best friend ⓑmoved ⓒto another city ⓓlast month, ⓔand I still miss him.
questions.why: one of 뒤에는 복수명사가 오므로 friend를 friends로 고쳐 one of my best friends로 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐAs the marathon went on, ⓑthe runners ⓒbecame ⓓmore and more tired, but they still ran ⓔas fast as possibly.
questions.why: possibly는 부사이므로 as ~ as 뒤에는 형용사 possible을 써서 as fast as possible로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Our school started a walking challenge last month. At first only ten students joined, but ⓐmore and more friends signed up every week. The teacher asked us to record our steps ⓑas careful as possible. Walking together became ⓒone of the happiest parts of my day. The path around the playground felt ⓓshorter and shorter as we got used to it. Now the challenge is ⓔone of the biggest events in our school.
questions.why: 동사 record를 꾸미는 자리이므로 형용사 careful이 아니라 부사 carefully를 써서 as carefully as possible로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Last summer I volunteered at a small animal shelter. On the first day I was nervous, but the work became ⓐeasier and easier. My job was to feed the puppies ⓑas quietly as possible so they would not be scared. One of the volunteers ⓒwas a high school student who came every weekend. She said the shelter was one of the ⓓbusiest place in the town. As more people heard about us, ⓔmore and more families came to adopt the dogs.
questions.why: 「one of the+최상급+복수명사」이므로 place를 복수형 places로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Yesterday our class held a cooking contest. We had only thirty minutes, so we cut the vegetables ⓐas quickly as we can. The kitchen got ⓑhotter and hotter, and our hands moved ⓒfaster and faster. In the end, our tomato pasta became ⓓone of the most delicious dishes on the table. The judge said it was ⓔone of the best ideas of the day.
questions.why: Yesterday로 시작하는 과거의 일이므로 「as ~ as 주어+can」의 can을 과거형 could로 고쳐 as quickly as we could로 써야 한다.
choices: ⓓ one of the most delicious dishes

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
· Answer the survey as soon as possible.
· The room became warm and warmer.
· One of the singers was late for the show.
· Jinho is one of the fastest runner in our club.
· The game is getting more and more interesting.
questions.why: 옳은 문장은 첫째·셋째·다섯째 세 개이다. 둘째는 warmer and warmer, 넷째는 runners로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
· The mountain path grew steep and steeper.
· She solved the puzzle as fast as she could.
· Seoul is one of the biggest city in Asia.
· One of the paintings on the wall are very old.
· Winters here are becoming milder and milder.
questions.why: 옳은 문장은 둘째·다섯째 두 개이다. 첫째는 steeper and steeper, 셋째는 cities, 넷째는 is로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
· Please arrive as early as you can.
· This is one of the strangest photos in the album.
· The bag felt heavier and heavier on my back.
· One of the chairs in the music room is broken.
· Study as harder as possible before the exam.
questions.why: 다섯째만 틀렸다. as ~ as possible 사이에는 원급이 오므로 harder를 hard로 고쳐야 한다. 나머지 네 문장은 옳다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
Finish your homework as (A)____ as possible.
The weather is getting (B)____ and colder.
Suji is one of the most talented (C)____ in the art class.
questions.why: (A)는 as ~ as 사이이므로 원급 early, (B)는 「비교급+and+비교급」이므로 colder, (C)는 최상급 뒤 복수명사 students가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
Our town is becoming (A)____ and more famous for its night market.
Wash the dishes as (B)____ as you can.
One of the stalls (C)____ selling fresh strawberries.
questions.why: (A) famous는 긴 형용사이므로 more and more, (B)는 동사 wash를 꾸미는 부사 carefully, (C)는 주어의 핵심이 One이므로 is가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
The line at the amusement park got (A)____ every hour.
We tried to take as (B)____ photos as possible before sunset.
It is one of the (C)____ theme parks in the country.
questions.why: (A)는 「비교급+and+비교급」, (B) photos는 셀 수 있는 명사이므로 many, (C)는 one of the 뒤 최상급 oldest가 알맞다.
choices: longer and longer - much - most old
long and longer - much - most old

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
Because of the rain, the river ran (A)____ and faster.
Explain the rule as (B)____ as you can so everyone understands.
Mr. Han is one of the kindest (C)____ I have ever met.
questions.why: (A)는 faster and faster, (B)는 동사 explain을 꾸미는 부사 simply, (C)는 최상급 뒤 복수명사 people이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
가능한 한 정확하게 답을 쓰세요.
questions.why: '가능한 한 ~하게'는 as ~ as possible이고, 동사 write를 꾸미므로 부사 exactly를 쓴다.
choices: Please write your answers exactly as possible.
Please write your answers as exactly as possibly.
Please write your answers exactly as possible as you.
Please write your answers as exactly as possible.
Please write your answers as more exactly as possible.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그 이야기는 점점 더 흥미진진해졌다.
questions.why: exciting은 긴 형용사이므로 「more and more+원급」으로 '점점 더 ~한'을 나타낸다.
choices: The story became more and more exciting.
The story became more exciting and exciting.
The story became excitinger and excitinger.
The story became much and much exciting.
The story became the more and the more exciting.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그 시장은 우리 도시에서 가장 붐비는 장소들 중 하나이다.
questions.why: 「one of the+최상급+복수명사」 형태이므로 the busiest places가 알맞다.
choices: The market is one of the busiest place in our city.
The market is one of busiest places in our city.
The market is the one of busiest places in our city.
The market is one of the most busiest places in our city.
The market is one of the busiest places in our city.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
나는 가능한 한 많은 책을 읽으려고 노력했다.
questions.why: books는 셀 수 있는 명사의 복수형이므로 「as many+복수명사+as possible」로 쓴다.
choices: I tried to read as much books as possible.
I tried to read as many book as possible.
I tried to read as many books as possible.
I tried to read as many books as possibly.
I tried to read books as many as possible.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: The bus leaves in five minutes!
B: Then let's run as ____ as we can.
questions.why: as ~ as 사이에는 원급이 오고, 동사 run을 꾸미는 부사 fast가 알맞다. fastly라는 말은 없다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Your guitar playing sounds great these days.
B: Thanks. I think it is getting ____.
questions.why: good의 비교급은 better이므로 「비교급+and+비교급」인 better and better가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Why do you like Yeongju Market so much?
B: Because it is one of the ____ markets in our region.
questions.why: one of the 뒤에는 최상급이 오므로 old의 최상급 oldest가 알맞다. 나머지는 모두 최상급을 잘못 만든 형태이다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Should I bring the report tomorrow?
B: No. Please give it to me as ____ as possible.
questions.why: as ~ as possible 사이에는 비교급이나 최상급이 아니라 원급이 오므로 soon이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
ⓐ The puppy is growing bigger and bigger.
ⓑ Send the file as soon as possibly.
ⓒ One of the desks in the lab is broken.
ⓓ Tokyo is one of the busiest city in the world.
ⓔ Answer the questions as careful as possible.
questions.why: 옳은 것은 ⓐ와 ⓒ이다. ⓑ는 possible, ⓓ는 cities, ⓔ는 부사 carefully로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
ⓐ My grandmother tells one of the funniest stories I know.
ⓑ The classroom became more and more noisier.
ⓒ Please explain it as simply as possible.
ⓓ One of the answers were wrong.
ⓔ Prices of fruit are getting higher and higher.
questions.why: 옳은 것은 ⓐ·ⓒ·ⓔ이다. ⓑ는 noisier and noisier, ⓓ는 주어의 핵심이 One이므로 was로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
ⓐ Save as much energy as possible in summer.
ⓑ He is one of the greatest inventor of our time.
ⓒ The line moved slower and slower.
ⓓ Return the borrowed tools as early as possibly.
ⓔ One of the doors are locked.
questions.why: 틀린 것은 ⓑ·ⓓ·ⓔ이다. ⓑ는 inventors, ⓓ는 possible, ⓔ는 is로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같도록 <보기>의 말을 모두 배열할 때, 네 번째로 오는 것은?
그녀는 가능한 한 크게 노래했다.
<보기> as / sang / loudly / she / possible / as
questions.why: She sang as loudly as possible.의 순서가 되므로 네 번째로 오는 말은 loudly이다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같도록 <보기>의 말을 모두 배열할 때, 다섯 번째로 오는 것은?
우리 도시에서 가장 오래된 다리들 중 하나는 백 년이 넘었다.
<보기> one / bridges / of / the / in our city / oldest
→ ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ is over a hundred years old.
questions.why: One of the oldest bridges in our city is over a hundred years old.의 순서이므로 다섯 번째는 bridges이다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Bring the ladder as quickly as possible.
= Bring the ladder ____.
questions.why: as ~ as possible은 「as ~ as 주어+can」으로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다. ②는 현재의 명령문이므로 could가 아니라 can을 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장과 뜻이 가장 가까운 것은?
The number of visitors to the museum keeps growing.
questions.why: '점점 더 많은'은 「비교급+and+비교급」인 more and more로 나타낸다.
choices: Visitors are coming much and much.
Visitors are coming more than more.
More and more visitors are coming.
Visitors are coming the more and the more.
Many and many visitors are coming.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Try to answer the quiz as ____ as possible.
questions.why: 동사 answer를 꾸미므로 부사 accurately를 쓰고, as ~ as possible 사이에는 비교급·최상급이 아니라 원급이 온다. accuracy·accurateness는 명사여서 이 자리에 올 수 없다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
My puppy is getting ____ and heavier every month.
questions.why: '점점 더 무거워지다'는 「비교급+and+비교급」이므로 heavier and heavier로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Seollal is one of the longest ____ in Korea.
questions.why: 「one of the+최상급+복수명사」이므로 longest 뒤에는 복수명사 holidays가 온다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Ms. Park asked us to keep the classroom as clean as ____.
questions.why: as ~ as possible의 형태이므로 형용사 possible이 알맞다. possibly는 부사이고 can은 주어 없이 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The dance steps in this class are becoming ____.
questions.why: complicated처럼 긴 형용사는 「more and more+원급」으로 '점점 더 ~한'을 나타낸다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
One of the students who won the prize ____ my cousin.
questions.why: 「one of+복수명사」가 주어이면 핵심은 One이므로 단수동사 is를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Last night I studied as long as I ____ before falling asleep.
questions.why: 과거의 일이므로 「as ~ as 주어+can」의 can을 과거형 could로 쓴다. possible을 쓰려면 주어 I가 없어야 한다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
One of the ____ things about winter is drinking hot cocoa.
questions.why: one of the 뒤에는 최상급이 오므로 good의 최상급 best가 알맞다. gooder·more good·most best는 없는 형태이고, well은 부사라서 명사 things를 꾸밀 수 없다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
As the deadline came closer, the team members worked ____.
questions.why: '점점 더 열심히'는 「비교급+and+비교급」인 harder and harder로 쓴다. hardly는 '거의 ~않다'라는 뜻이라 의미가 맞지 않는다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The chef used as ____ sugar as possible in the new recipe.
questions.why: sugar는 셀 수 없는 명사이므로 「as little+셀 수 없는 명사+as possible」로 쓴다. few는 셀 수 있는 명사에 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[방과 후 교실]
questions.why: ①의 possibly는 부사이므로 형용사 possible로 고쳐 as fast as possible로 써야 한다.
choices: Hand in your report as fast as possibly.
The room got quieter and quieter after the bell.
Mina is one of the smartest girls in our grade.
Please repeat the sentence as slowly as you can.
The playground is getting muddier and muddier.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[반려동물]
questions.why: ③은 「비교급+and+비교급」이므로 fat을 fatter로 바꿔 fatter and fatter로 써야 한다.
choices: My cat sleeps as much as possible in winter.
One of my hamsters is missing.
Our dog is getting fat and fatter.
Feeding pets is one of the most important duties.
Walk the dog as often as you can.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[스마트폰 사용]
questions.why: ② as ~ as possible 사이에는 원급이 오므로 비교급 less를 원급 little로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Smartphones are one of the most common tools in class today.
Use your phone as less as possible while studying.
The battery is running out faster and faster.
Charge it as early as possible before the trip.
More and more people read books on their phones.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[음악 시간]
questions.why: ⑤는 최상급 뒤에 복수명사가 와야 하므로 group을 groups로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Practice the recorder as often as you can.
Playing the piano is one of her greatest joys.
That melody became more and more popular.
Sing as clearly as possible during the test.
The choir club is one of the largest group in our city.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[미술관 관람]
questions.why: ④는 주어의 핵심이 One이므로 were를 was로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: The museum is one of the oldest buildings downtown.
Look at the paintings as closely as possible.
The hall became more and more crowded after lunch.
One of the guides were explaining the picture.
Take notes as quickly as you can.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[아침 등교]
questions.why: ②가 옳다. ①은 possible, ③은 places, ④는 내일의 일이므로 can, ⑤는 longer and longer로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: I ran as fast as possibly to catch the school bus.
The mornings are getting darker and darker.
Subway stations are one of the most crowded place.
Leave home as early as you could tomorrow.
The line for the bus grew long and longer.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[교실 청소]
questions.why: ④가 옳다. ①은 possible, ②는 is, ③은 shinier and shinier, ⑤는 최상급 뒤 복수명사 places로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Wipe the windows as clean as possibly.
One of the brooms are broken.
The floor became shiny and shinier.
Cleaning day is one of the busiest days of the month.
The corner behind the door is one of the dirtiest place.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[수학 시험]
questions.why: ①이 옳다. ②는 부사 carefully, ③은 better and better, ④는 tests, ⑤는 과거이므로 could로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: One of the questions was too difficult for me.
Solve the problems as careful as possible.
My score is getting good and better.
This is one of the hardest test of the year.
I reviewed as much as I can last night.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[해외 여행]
questions.why: ③이 옳다. ①은 busier and busier, ②는 possible, ④는 was, ⑤는 phrases로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Airports are getting busy and busier in summer.
Exchange money as early as possibly.
Paris is one of the most visited cities in Europe.
One of my suitcases were lost at the airport.
Learn as many phrase as possible before you go.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐPlease water ⓑas many plant as ⓒpossible ⓓbefore you ⓔleave the greenhouse.
questions.why: many 뒤에는 복수명사가 오므로 plant를 plants로 고쳐 as many plants as possible로 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐThe crowd ⓑat the stadium ⓒgrew ⓓbigger ⓔand big as the game started.
questions.why: 「비교급+and+비교급」이므로 big을 bigger로 고쳐 bigger and bigger로 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐOne of the ⓑmost famous ⓒpaintings ⓓwere ⓔstolen from the gallery last year.
questions.why: 「one of+복수명사」가 주어이면 핵심은 One이므로 were를 was로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐMore and more students ⓑare becoming ⓒinterest ⓓin the school ⓔrecycling program.
questions.why: become 뒤에는 형용사가 와야 하므로 명사 interest를 interested로 고쳐야 한다. ⓐ는 「비교급+and+비교급」이 바르게 쓰였다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Our school band started with only four members. We practiced ⓐas often as possible after class. Little by little, our sound became ⓑbetter and better. Last May we played at the school festival, and it was ⓒone of the proudest moment of my life. Since then, ⓓmore and more students have joined the club. Now the band is ⓔone of the largest clubs in our school.
questions.why: 「one of the+최상급+복수명사」이므로 moment를 복수형 moments로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: ⓓ more and more students have joined

questions.stem:
다음 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
My grandfather grows tomatoes behind his house. Every morning he waters them ⓐas early as possible. In June the plants grow ⓑtaller and taller, and the fruit turns ⓒredder and redder. He says growing food is ⓓone of the most peaceful hobbies in the world. This summer, one of the tomatoes ⓔwere as big as my fist.
questions.why: 주어의 핵심은 One이므로 were를 단수동사 was로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: ⓓ one of the most peaceful hobbies

questions.stem:
다음 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Last week our class joined a recycling campaign. We collected ⓐas many cans as possible from the playground. The bags got ⓑheavy and heavier as we walked. Our teacher told us that recycling is ⓒone of the easiest ways to protect the earth. After the campaign, ⓓmore and more classes wanted to join. The playground now looks ⓔcleaner and cleaner every week.
questions.why: 「비교급+and+비교급」이므로 heavy를 heavier로 고쳐 heavier and heavier로 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
· Please reply to my message as soon as possible.
· That is one of the best bakeries near the station.
· The wind blew strong and stronger.
· One of the bicycles need a new tire.
· The lake is becoming more and more polluted.
questions.why: 옳은 문장은 첫째·둘째·다섯째 세 개이다. 셋째는 stronger and stronger, 넷째는 needs로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
· Ride your bike as safely as possibly.
· Everest is one of the highest mountain in the world.
· The soup tasted salty and saltier.
· One of the boys were shouting in the hall.
· Bring as many blankets as possible for the camp.
questions.why: 다섯째만 옳다. 첫째는 possible, 둘째는 mountains, 셋째는 saltier and saltier, 넷째는 was로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
· Finish your part as early as possible.
· The nights are getting cooler and cooler.
· One of the easiest ways to relax is listening to music.
· Read the notice as carefully as you can.
· Our school is one of the smallest schools in this area.
questions.why: 다섯 문장 모두 옳다. as ~ as possible, 「비교급+and+비교급」, 「one of the+최상급+복수명사」가 모두 바르게 쓰였다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
Please water the plants as (A)____ as possible.
The classroom is getting (B)____ and hotter.
Ms. Yun is one of the (C)____ teachers in our school.
questions.why: (A)는 as ~ as 사이이므로 원급 often, (B)는 hotter and hotter, (C)는 one of the 뒤 최상급 kindest가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
Table tennis is one of the fastest (A)____ in the world.
The stadium became (B)____ and noisier.
Take as (C)____ pictures as you can during the game!
questions.why: (A)는 최상급 뒤 복수명사 sports, (B)는 noisier and noisier, (C) pictures는 셀 수 있는 명사이므로 many가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
As the train left the city, the buildings became (A)____.
I closed the door as (B)____ as I could.
This is one of the (C)____ trips I have ever taken.
questions.why: (A) buildings는 셀 수 있는 명사이므로 fewer and fewer, (B)는 동사 closed를 꾸미는 부사 gently, (C)는 one of the 뒤 최상급 most exciting이 알맞다.
choices: fewer and fewer - gently - most exciting
fewer and fewer - gentle - most exciting
less and less - gently - most exciting
fewer and fewer - gently - more exciting
few and fewer - gentle - most exciting

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
One of the volunteers (A)____ handing out water bottles.
The runners were breathing (B)____ near the finish line.
Try to drink as (C)____ water as possible during the race.
questions.why: (A)는 주어의 핵심이 One이므로 is, (B)는 harder and harder, (C) water는 셀 수 없는 명사이므로 much가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그 아기는 점점 더 크게 울었다.
questions.why: '점점 더 ~하게'는 「비교급+and+비교급」이므로 louder and louder가 알맞다.
choices: The baby cried loud and loud.
The baby cried louder and louder.
The baby cried more and more loud.
The baby cried the louder and the louder.
The baby cried loudly and loudly.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
이것은 내가 본 가장 슬픈 영화들 중 하나이다.
questions.why: 「one of the+최상급+복수명사」이므로 the saddest movies가 알맞다.
choices: This is one of the saddest movie I have ever seen.
This is the one of saddest movies I have ever seen.
This is one of most sad movies I have ever seen.
This is one of the saddest movies I have ever seen.
This is one of the sadder movies I have ever seen.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그는 가능한 한 조심스럽게 상자를 옮겼다.
questions.why: 동사 carried를 꾸미므로 부사 carefully를 쓰고, '가능한 한'은 as ~ as possible로 나타낸다.
choices: He carried the box as careful as possible.
He carried the box as carefully as possibly.
He carried the box carefully as possible as he.
He carried the box as more carefully as possible.
He carried the box as carefully as possible.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
우리 마을을 방문하는 관광객이 점점 더 많아지고 있다.
questions.why: '점점 더 많은'은 many의 비교급을 겹쳐 쓴 more and more로 나타낸다.
choices: More and more tourists are visiting our town.
Much and much tourists are visiting our town.
Many and many tourists are visiting our town.
More than more tourists are visiting our town.
The more and the more tourists are visiting our town.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Why is everyone talking about that new bakery?
B: Because it is one of the ____ bakeries in our neighborhood.
questions.why: one of the 뒤에는 최상급이 오므로 good의 최상급 best가 알맞다. most good·goodest·more better는 없는 형태이고 well은 부사이다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: You look really tired today.
B: I studied as ____ as I could last night.
questions.why: as ~ as 사이에는 원급이 오므로 long이 알맞다. 과거이므로 뒤에 could가 쓰였다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: How was the hiking trail?
B: It got ____ near the top, so we had to rest twice.
questions.why: '점점 더 가팔라지다'는 「비교급+and+비교급」이므로 steeper and steeper가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: When do I have to return this borrowed umbrella?
B: Just give it back as ____ as you can.
questions.why: 「as ~ as 주어+can」 사이에는 원급이 오므로 soon이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
ⓐ Turn off the tap as quickly as possible.
ⓑ The market became more and more busier.
ⓒ One of the shops sells homemade cookies.
ⓓ Gyeongju is one of the most historic city in Korea.
ⓔ The bread smelled better and better as it baked.
questions.why: 옳은 것은 ⓐ·ⓒ·ⓔ이다. ⓑ는 busier and busier, ⓓ는 cities로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
ⓐ Answer the phone as more quickly as possible.
ⓑ One of the largest deserts is the Sahara.
ⓒ The sky grew clearer and clearer.
ⓓ Buy as much apples as possible at the market.
ⓔ Winter here is one of the coldest seasons.
questions.why: 틀린 것은 ⓐ와 ⓓ이다. ⓐ는 as ~ as possible 사이에 비교급을 쓸 수 없으므로 as quickly as possible, ⓓ는 apples가 셀 수 있는 명사이므로 as many apples as possible로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
ⓐ My sister is one of the tallest players on the team.
ⓑ The homework pile got high and higher.
ⓒ Wake up as early as possible tomorrow.
ⓓ One of the lights in the hallway are off.
ⓔ Trains in this country are becoming faster and faster.
questions.why: 옳은 것은 ⓐ·ⓒ·ⓔ이다. ⓑ는 higher and higher, ⓓ는 is로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같도록 <보기>의 말을 모두 배열할 때, 세 번째로 오는 것은?
가능한 한 빨리 저에게 전화해 주세요.
<보기> me / please / as / call / possible / as / soon

다음 두 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Gwangjang Market is very old. Few markets in Seoul are older than this one.
<조건> one of와 oldest를 사용할 것
questions.answer: Gwangjang Market is one of the oldest markets in Seoul.
questions.why: '가장 ~한 것들 중 하나'는 「one of the+최상급+복수명사」로 쓰므로 the oldest markets가 된다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Mr. Lee is a teacher in our school. No teacher in our school is kinder than him.
<조건> one of와 kindest를 사용할 것
questions.answer: Mr. Lee is one of the kindest teachers in our school.
questions.why: 최상급 뒤에는 복수명사가 오므로 the kindest teachers로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Copy the notes into your notebook. Copy them as neatly as you can.
<조건> possible을 사용하여 명령문 한 문장으로 쓸 것
questions.answer: Copy the notes into your notebook as neatly as possible.
questions.why: 「as ~ as 주어+can」을 as ~ as possible로 바꿔 한 문장으로 잇는다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Last year one hundred people joined the marathon. This year five hundred people joined it.
<조건> 1. More로 시작할 것  2. 총 8단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: More and more people are joining the marathon.
questions.why: '점점 더 많은'은 more and more이다. More / and / more / people / are / joining / the / marathon의 8단어이다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Sujin swims on our school team. No other swimmer on the team is faster than her.
<조건> one of와 fastest를 사용할 것
questions.answer: Sujin is one of the fastest swimmers on our team.
questions.why: 「one of the+최상급+복수명사」 형태로 the fastest swimmers를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
I wanted to finish the puzzle. I wanted to finish it as early as I could.
<조건> 1. possible을 사용할 것  2. 총 10단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: I wanted to finish the puzzle as early as possible.
questions.why: I / wanted / to / finish / the / puzzle / as / early / as / possible의 10단어이다.

name: 상관접속사 지정문법
points: not only A but also B

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Both the science club and the drama club ____ new members this month.
questions.why: 「both A and B」는 언제나 복수 취급하므로 복수동사 need가 알맞다. 나머지는 모두 단수 주어에 쓰는 형태다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Neither the coach ____ the players were satisfied with the result.
questions.why: neither는 nor와 짝을 이룬다(neither A nor B: A도 B도 아니다). or와 짝을 이루는 것은 either이다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Either Minji ____ Sujin will read the opening speech.
questions.why: either는 or와 짝을 이룬다(either A or B: A나 B 둘 중 하나). nor는 neither와, and는 both와 짝을 이룬다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Not only the roof but ____ the walls need painting.
questions.why: 「not only A but also B」(A뿐만 아니라 B도)가 한 짝이다. too는 문장 끝에 쓰는 부사라 but 뒤에 바로 올 수 없다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
____ my father and my uncle grow tomatoes on the rooftop.
questions.why: 뒤에 and가 있으므로 and와 짝을 이루는 Both를 쓴다. either는 or, neither는 nor, not only는 but also와 짝을 이룬다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
My brothers as well as my cousin ____ to the same gym every evening.
questions.why: 「A as well as B」는 앞에 있는 A(My brothers)에 동사를 맞추므로 복수동사 go가 알맞다. 나머지는 모두 단수 주어에 쓰는 형태다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
____ the printer nor the scanner works in this room.
questions.why: 뒤에 nor가 있으므로 nor와 짝을 이루는 Neither를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
____ Sunday or Monday is fine for our club meeting.
questions.why: 뒤에 or가 있으므로 or와 짝을 이루는 Either를 쓴다. '둘 중 하나'라는 뜻이다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Not only the museum guide but also the visitors ____ surprised by the old painting.
questions.why: 「not only A but also B」는 B(the visitors)에 동사를 맞춘다. 복수이므로 were가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Either the twins or their mother ____ the plants every morning.
questions.why: 「either A or B」는 동사에 가까운 B(their mother)에 맞춘다. 단수이므로 waters가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Neither the goalkeeper nor the defenders ____ ready for the final match.
questions.why: 「neither A nor B」도 가까운 B(the defenders)에 동사를 맞춘다. 복수이므로 were가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Both the recipe and the video ____ helpful to beginners.
questions.why: 단수명사 두 개를 both A and B로 묶어도 언제나 복수 취급하므로 are가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The players as well as the captain ____ hard for the final game.
questions.why: 「A as well as B」는 앞의 A(The players)에 맞추므로 복수동사 practice가 알맞다. 나머지는 모두 단수 주어에 쓰는 형태다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
What surprised us was not the price ____ the size of the box.
questions.why: 「not A but B」는 'A가 아니라 B'라는 뜻으로 not은 but과 짝을 이룬다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
He not only washed the dishes but also ____ the floor.
questions.why: not only와 but also는 같은 형태를 연결한다. 앞이 과거형 washed이므로 뒤에도 과거형 cleaned를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Either my sisters or my brother ____ going to carry the tent.
questions.why: 「either A or B」는 동사에 가까운 B(my brother)에 맞추므로 단수동사 is가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[동아리 소개]
questions.why: ①의 both A and B는 복수 취급이므로 plays를 play로 고쳐야 한다. ②~④는 동사에 가까운 주어에, ⑤는 as well as 앞의 주어에 동사를 맞춘 옳은 문장이다.
choices: Both Mina and her brother plays the violin.
Neither the guitar nor the drums are new.
Either Friday or Saturday works for me.
Not only the members but also the leader wants a new poster.
The teacher as well as the students enjoys the club fair.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[학교 급식실]
questions.why: ③은 동사에 가까운 the helpers가 복수이므로 is를 are로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Both the soup and the salad were fresh today.
Neither the rice nor the beans have been cooked yet.
Either the cook or the helpers is washing the trays.
Not only the plates but also the cups need washing.
The menu as well as the prices has changed.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[교실 대화]
questions.why: ②의 neither는 or가 아니라 nor와 짝을 이루므로 or를 nor로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Both of my parents work at the same hospital.
Neither Jiwon or Taemin brought an umbrella.
Either you or your partner has to present first.
Not only the bus but also the subway was crowded.
My brother as well as my cousins likes baseball.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[봉사 활동 안내]
questions.why: ④는 not only 뒤의 to collect와 but also 뒤의 recycling이 형태가 달라 병렬이 깨졌다. to collect를 collecting으로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Both washing cars and planting trees are good ways to help.
Neither the volunteers nor the manager was late.
Either sending letters or making cards is welcome.
Not only to collect cans but also recycling paper helps the earth.
Reading to children as well as cleaning parks counts as service.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[여행 계획]
questions.why: ⑤는 as well as 앞의 The tickets가 복수이므로 is를 are로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Both the train and the ferry stop at that island.
Neither my aunt nor my uncle drives at night.
Either the hotel or the guesthouses have free breakfast.
Not only the price but also the location matters to us.
The tickets as well as the map is in my bag.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[과학 시간]
questions.why: ①의 both A and B는 복수 취급이므로 affects를 affect로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Both the moon and the sun affects the tides.
Neither the students nor the teacher was late for the experiment.
Either salt or sugar dissolves quickly in warm water.
Not only the seeds but also the soil was ready for the test.
The report as well as the photos was sent to the teacher.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[문장 바꿔 쓰기]
questions.why: ②의 as well as는 앞의 The shoes(복수)에 동사를 맞추므로 was를 were로 고쳐야 한다. 나머지는 모두 가까운 주어나 both의 규칙을 지킨 문장이다.
choices: Not only the shoes but also the jacket was on sale.
The shoes as well as the jacket was on sale.
Both the shoes and the jacket were on sale.
Neither the shoes nor the jacket was on sale.
Either the shoes or the jacket was on sale.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[동아리 발표]
questions.why: ④는 조동사 can 뒤이므로 동사원형이 와야 한다. speaks를 speak로, writes를 write로 고쳐야 병렬도 맞는다.
choices: She is not only a singer but also a dancer.
He wants either to join the band or to lead the choir.
We can both save money and help the earth.
She can not only speaks Chinese but also writes it.
The show was neither long nor boring.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[반려동물]
questions.why: ③은 가까운 주어 the nurses가 복수이므로 are가 맞다. ①은 sleep, ②는 or를 nor로, ④는 need, ⑤는 love로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Both my cat and my dog sleeps on the sofa.
Neither the puppy or the kitten likes baths.
Either the vet or the nurses are coming this afternoon.
Not only the food but also the bowls needs washing.
My cats as well as my dog loves the park.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[학교 축제]
questions.why: ⑤는 as well as 앞의 The band에 맞춰 practices를 썼으므로 옳다. ①은 were, ②·④는 가까운 주어가 복수이므로 are와 were, ③은 is가 되어야 한다.
choices: Both the stage and the lights was ready.
Neither the dancer nor the singers is nervous.
Either Mr. Kim or Ms. Park are going to host the show.
Not only the poster but also the tickets was printed.
The band as well as the choir practices every evening.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[도서관 이용]
questions.why: ①의 both A and B는 복수 취급이므로 open이 맞다. ②는 know, ③은 and를 or로, ④는 enjoy, ⑤는 have로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Both the reading room and the study room open at nine.
Neither the librarian nor the students knows the password.
Either the e-books and the magazines can be borrowed.
Not only children but also adults enjoys the story hour.
The hours as well as the rule has changed.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[문장 연결하기]
questions.why: ④는 neither와 nor가 과거동사 called와 sent를 같은 형태로 연결하여 옳다. ①은 to swim, ②는 kind, ③은 take, ⑤는 boring이 되어야 한다.
choices: He likes not only to run but also swimming.
She is both kindness and helpful.
We can either walk or taking the bus.
They neither called us nor sent a message.
The class was not only long but also bored.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[학급 회의]
questions.why: ②는 가까운 주어 the banner가 단수이므로 was가 맞다. ①·④는 가까운 주어가 복수이므로 are, ③은 or를 and로, ⑤는 need로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Not only the board but also the desks is dirty.
Neither the posters nor the banner was finished.
Both the plan or the budget need to change.
Either the girl or the boys is cleaning the window.
The chairs as well as the table needs repair.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[요리 실습]
questions.why: ③은 가까운 주어 the milk가 단수이므로 is가 맞다. ①은 are, ②는 are, ④는 are, ⑤는 have로 고쳐야 한다.
choices: Both flour and sugar is needed for this cake.
Neither the oven nor the pans is hot enough.
Either the eggs or the milk is in the fridge.
Not only the taste but also the smells is great.
The students as well as the chef has finished.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
[병렬 구조 점검]
questions.why: ⑤는 not only와 but also가 형용사 cheap과 safe를 같은 형태로 연결하여 옳다. 나머지는 앞뒤 형태가 서로 다르다.
choices: He can not only draw but also he paints well.
Both to sing and dancing make her happy.
She is famous not for her voice but she writes songs.
We should either call him or sending a text.
The trip was not only cheap but also safe.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐBoth the museum ⓑand the gallery ⓒnear the river ⓓopen at ten and ⓔcloses at six.
questions.why: 주어가 both A and B이므로 복수 취급한다. 앞의 open과 짝이 되도록 ⓔ closes를 close로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐNeither the driver ⓑnor the passengers ⓒwas hurt ⓓin the accident ⓔlast night.
questions.why: neither A nor B는 동사에 가까운 B(the passengers)에 맞춘다. 복수이므로 ⓒ was를 were로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐEither Sumin ⓑand her cousins ⓒwill take care ⓓof the rabbits ⓔthis weekend.
questions.why: either는 or와 짝을 이루므로 ⓑ and를 or로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐNot only the writer ⓑbut also the artists ⓒof this comic book ⓓvisits our school ⓔevery spring.
questions.why: not only A but also B는 B(the artists)에 동사를 맞춘다. 복수이므로 ⓓ visits를 visit로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐEither ⓑthe printer ⓒnor the copier ⓓworks well ⓔin this office.
questions.why: 뒤에 nor가 있으므로 ⓐ Either를 Neither로 고쳐야 짝이 맞는다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐShe not only ⓑwriting the song ⓒbut also ⓓsang it ⓔat the school concert.
questions.why: not only와 but also는 같은 형태를 연결한다. 뒤가 과거동사 sang이므로 ⓑ writing을 wrote로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
ⓐEither the students ⓑor the teacher ⓒhas to ⓓclose the windows ⓔand locks the door.
questions.why: has to 뒤의 close와 짝이 되어야 하므로 ⓔ locks를 lock으로 고쳐야 한다. ⓒ는 가까운 주어 the teacher에 맞춘 옳은 형태다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그 소설은 재미있을 뿐만 아니라 감동적이기도 하다.
questions.why: 'A뿐만 아니라 B도'는 not only A but also B이다. ③은 '둘 중 하나', ④는 '둘 다 아니다', ⑤는 '재미있는 것이 아니라 감동적인'이라는 뜻이 된다.
choices: The novel is only not interesting but also touching.
The novel is not only interesting but also touching.
The novel is either interesting or touching.
The novel is neither interesting nor touching.
The novel is not interesting but touching.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
민호와 지아는 둘 다 그 대회에 참가했다.
questions.why: '둘 다'는 both A and B로 나타낸다. ①은 '둘 중 하나', ②는 '둘 다 아니다'라는 뜻이다.
choices: Either Minho or Jia took part in the contest.
Neither Minho nor Jia took part in the contest.
Not Minho but Jia took part in the contest.
Both Minho and Jia took part in the contest.
Minho as well as Jia did not take part in the contest.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
수진이뿐만 아니라 그녀의 부모님도 그 소식을 알고 계신다.
questions.why: not only A but also B는 B(her parents)에 동사를 맞추므로 know가 맞다. ③은 강조 대상이 뒤바뀌었고 ④·⑤는 뜻이 다르다.
choices: Not only Sujin but also her parents know the news.
Not only Sujin but also her parents knows the news.
Not only her parents but also Sujin know the news.
Either Sujin or her parents knows the news.
Neither Sujin nor her parents know the news.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그녀는 의사가 아니라 수의사이다.
questions.why: 'A가 아니라 B'는 not A but B이다. ①·④는 '의사이면서 수의사'라는 뜻이 되고 ②는 '둘 중 하나', ③은 '둘 다 아니다'라는 뜻이다.
choices: She is not only a doctor but also a vet.
She is either a doctor or a vet.
She is neither a doctor nor a vet.
She is a doctor as well as a vet.
She is not a doctor but a vet.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그 가방은 가벼울 뿐만 아니라 방수도 된다.
questions.why: 「B as well as A」는 'A뿐만 아니라 B도'라는 뜻이므로 강조되는 waterproof가 앞에 온다. ④는 '가볍지만 방수는 안 된다'는 뜻이라 우리말과 다르다.
choices: The bag is light as well as it is waterproof.
The bag is not light but waterproof.
The bag is waterproof as well as light.
The bag is light but not waterproof.
The bag is either light or waterproof.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그 식당은 일요일에도 월요일에도 문을 열지 않는다.
questions.why: 'A도 B도 아니다'는 neither A nor B이다.
choices: The restaurant opens either on Sunday or on Monday.
The restaurant opens neither on Sunday nor on Monday.
The restaurant opens both on Sunday and on Monday.
The restaurant opens not on Sunday but on Monday.
The restaurant opens on Sunday as well as on Monday.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
너나 네 남동생 둘 중 한 명이 개를 산책시켜야 한다.
questions.why: '둘 중 한 명'은 either A or B이고, 가까운 주어 your brother에 맞춰 has를 쓴다. ①은 have, ⑤는 has가 되어야 하고 ②·③은 뜻이 다르다.
choices: Both you and your brother has to walk the dog.
Neither you nor your brother has to walk the dog.
You as well as your brother have to walk the dog.
Either you or your brother has to walk the dog.
Not you but your brother have to walk the dog.

questions.stem:

A: Who is going to bring the snacks tomorrow?
B: ____ Jimin and Haeun are bringing them.
questions.why: 뒤에 and가 있고 동사가 복수 are이므로 Both가 알맞다.

questions.stem:

A: Did anyone answer the phone this morning?
B: No. ____ Dad nor Mom was at home.

questions.stem:

questions.why: not only A but also B는 B(the park)에 동사를 맞춘다. 단수이고 지난 일이므로 was가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

B: Either Wednesday or Thursday ____ fine with me.
questions.why: either A or B는 가까운 주어 Thursday에 맞추므로 단수동사 is가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Why do you go to that bakery every day?
B: Because the bread there is not only fresh ____ cheap.
questions.why: not only는 but also와 짝을 이루어 'A뿐만 아니라 B도'라는 뜻을 나타낸다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
[방과 후 수업 안내]

choices: Both the piano class and the art class start next week.
Neither the teacher nor the students has finished the survey.
Either Tuesday or Thursday is possible for the extra class.
Not only the classroom but also the hallway was decorated.
The notice as well as the photos was put on the wall.
